verse: sarvotkṛṣṭatamatve'aapi vimarśagrasanākulā | caturthīṃ laharīṃ viddhi śāṃbhavī kālabhakṣakī
surakṣitaṃ pradātavyaṃ sādhakāya mahātmanaḥ | etāsāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca guruvaktragatāni ca
ādau tāvat mukhāmnāyaṃ svamukhacalanena ca | grāhyaṃ prāṇāntikaṃ tattvaṃ tataḥ pūjā *?ma*?bheta
sarvasvaṃ sarvadehasthaṃ sarvādyaṃ sarvakāraṇam | sarvopamāmatikrāntaṃ śāstraṃ śāstravivarjitam
prāpyate paramaṃ cakraṃ khacakramakulaṃ kulam | tasmāt tvaṃ tu mahāvīra paryāye bhāvyate sadā
haṭharāvā  arāvasthā rāveṇa haṭhabhakṣakī  ||2/28 ||
bhairavasya samurcchasya uttiṣṭha vahatāṃ varaiḥ (?) ||2/1 ||
viddhi bhairava tattvena svasticakrasyabodhakam | kodaṇḍauṇḍetaraṃ dābhā aṣṭasyaṇḍika kodare
sthiticakraṃ tu jānīyād ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu adhunā śṛṇu | sṛṣṭiprathamagaṃ varṇaṃ saṃhārādaṣṭameyutam
śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me paramaṃ guhyaṃ siddhapāraṃparāgatam | yoginīnāṃ paraṃ sāraṃ kramasadbhāvamuttamam
śrībhairavyuvāca kiṃ vā tu parameśāna pṛcchase māṃ kapāladhṛk | kiṃ vā prayojanaṃ te vai kiṃ vā praśnasya kāraṇam
bhavati sā kramārthābhā viditvā kālikākramam | iti śrīmaduttarapīṭhavinirgate śrīśrīnāthapādāvatārite śrīkālikākramakramasadbhāve catuḥṣaṣṭivibhavāvatāro nāma dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ
mahāraśmisamūhena  bhāsamānāḥ  samantataḥ ||2/20 ||
pūjanīyāstu vai nityaṃ vīradravyaistu tāḥ sadā | advayācārabhāvena vīrācāreṇa bhairava
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā puṣpadhūpopahārakaiḥ | tatastu mātṛkāṃ devīṃ tridhā kuryāt tridhā tridhā
namo nitye tvanitye ca namaḥ sadā mahātmike | namaḥ kuleśi kauleśi vijñānavibhave namaḥ
yoginyo yogamārgasthāḥ kāḥ pūjyāḥ satatoditāḥ | kairdravyaiḥ pūjayed devi sṛṣṭicakraṃ mahojjvalam
etat tṛtīyaṃ deveśa caturthamadhunā śṛṇu | daśamaṃ sṛṣṭicakrasya saṃhārodaṣṭanairyutam
siddhāśca parameśāni tvatprasādāvatāritāḥ | pāramparyakramāyātā mukhāmukhayane sthitāḥ
anulome pramānākhyāṃ kālaṃsaṃkarṣayet paraṃ | (?) kālasya sarvabhakṣasya hehaṃ vai kalāsaṃbhavam
caturdaśena saṃyuktaṃ bhīmarūpaṃ mahotkaṭam | sthiticakrasya kālānte tavāstreṇa tu lāṃcchitam
kṛtvā svacakraṃ śrīcakraṃ kālaṃ nirnāśanaṃ param | ūrdhvariśmyārūḍhā kālī vidyārūpā manonmanī
na lekhyaṃ lekhanīyaṃ vā na ca jāpāntaraṃ kvacit | na śuddhaṃ na ca vāśuddhaṃ na śāktaṃ na ca śāṃbhavam
namaḥ kṛtāntadurdāntakālasya karaṇodyate | namo māyādivaibhavyai viśvajṛmbhe rakṣa me
tava snehena vakṣyāmi vistareṇa yathāvidhiḥ  ||2/25 ||
gandharvaiḥ kinnarairdivyaiḥ sādhyaiśca  vasubhistathā ||1/ 46 ||
yena vijñānamātreṇa kramavijñānabhāvagaḥ | bhavate sādhakendro vai bodhābodhavibodhakaḥ
tatrasthā dvādaśairbhedaiḥ ṣoḍaśaiśca tu matragā | niḥsvabhāvapadāntasthā bhakṣakītuṃ ca tantu dehagā
tārayet sarvajantūnāṃ araṇḍa paśvaśca? sadā | praviṣṭasya praviṣṭā sā niryā *? gantugāminī
mantrabhūmestu tā devi bhūmayaḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ | caturviṃśatibhedānāṃ samyag sūtraṃ prakāśayet
sthiticakrasya yad varṇaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca sarvakāmadam | etaccaturdaśaṃ varṇaṃ viddhi kālakṣayaṃkaram
pūjitavyaṃ prayatnena sarvagrasanalolupam | rakṣayet prāṇavad yatnena caurebhyo draviṇaṃ yathā
adhomārgena rephatvaṃ sarvatra pānalolupā | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
sṛṣṭicakrasya deveśa daśamaṃ sarvathoditam | saṃhārāt saptamaṃ yuktaṃ sthiternavamalāṃcchitam
saṃhāraṇopasaṃyuktā prapañcāṃvabhāvataḥ | vādya tu vartalāre antasvaraistu sāvṛtā
aṣṭamena adhaḥkrāntaṃ caturdaśamasaṃyutam | sthitivarṇamavarṇena līlayā lāṃchitaṃ kuru
bhargasya jñānamādāya devī sā khaṃ samāgatā | kālakālakalārūḍhā ārūḍhā rūḍhagā parā
saṃhārādaṣṭamaṃ varṇaṃ sthiternavamalāṃcchitam | prathamaṃ taṃ vijānīyād dvitīyamadhunā śṛṇu
tasmāt tvaṃ vīravīrendra pūjako bhava nityaśaḥ | toyena pūjitamātreṇa siddhasantānapāragam
tataḥ stutvā hyato rudra pūjāṃ tasyāḥ samārabhet | ṣaḍarasya sadā madhye pūjyā sā sthitikālinī
melāpe militā sā vai śabdasya paramā citiḥ | (1) tvaggatā sarvabhūteṣu viśve'aasmin sacarācare
khaṇḍajñānena sā devī khaṇḍacakraikatāṃ gatā | bhāsvarairdivasairyuktā (?) śikhā bhargasya cottamā
guptācāreṇa vai nityaṃ pañcadhā tu yathārthataḥ | idaṃ vai yoginīcakraṃ khecaratvapradāyakam
mūrtyānāṃ paramā mūrtiḥ ṣoḍaśānāṃ yathārthataḥ | idānīṃ parayā bhaktyā śrotumicchāmi bhairavi
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi saṃhārasya yathāvidhiḥ | pūjaye parayā bhaktyā kuru me ---------------- śrī yatraṣaśiva śakti śrī nātha aśeṣapmaraṃ paryakrama svagurupṛ *?mvujaṃ yāvat prāṇaumi
ālikhet tu tṛtīyaṃ vai cakraṃ saṃhārakārakam | atyutkaṭaṃ mahādīptaṃ svaraśmiśatasaṃkulam
śuddhabuddhepadaṃ brahmā nairūpyadharmavāhana | tatastū yamārahite saṃyojya vidhināhare
eta sa* * *? tathyaṃ kathayasva mamepsitam | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu tattvaṃ yathārthaṃ vai sṛṣṭicakrasya yā vidhiḥ
kathitāstu samāsena khecakre tu yathā matāḥ  ||2/22 ||
2/? ghrātā ghrātā vinirmuktā jñānena samatāṃ gatā | ? pañcānāṃ svasvabhāvānāṃ tridhāmā sā vyavasthitā
